parsed.rationale: The rhythm is regular at about 80 bpm with narrow QRS complexes, and there is no pathological Q wave or reciprocal ST depression. The mild, concave ST elevation in V2-V4 comes with tall T waves, which fits a normal or early-repolarization variant, so it does not meet STEMI criteria.
